tracks.name: Drums - Dry 2-Step Pattern
tracks.suggestedPreset: Swap the empty Drum Rack for a Garage, 606, 707, or short 909-style kit.
tracks.soundNotes: Intentionally dry by default; add roomy reverb only for niche distant/atmospheric UKG.
tracks.description: A dry swung 2-step pattern with syncopated kicks, snappy backbeats, and shuffled hats.

tracks.name: Perc - Shuffled Tops
tracks.suggestedPreset: Use short shuffled hats, snaps, and rim samples; keep delay low.
tracks.description: Extra shuffled tops and small percussive answers reinforce the garage feel.

tracks.name: Bass - Operator Shuffled Sub
tracks.description: A swung sub pattern answers the kick rather than simply following it.

tracks.name: Chords - Wavetable Seventh Stabs
tracks.suggestedPreset: Dial Wavetable toward organ/M1-style stabs or swap for a stock organ/electric preset.
tracks.description: Seventh-chord stabs supply the soulful UKG color and leave rhythmic gaps for the drums.

tracks.name: Hook - Pluck Chops
tracks.description: A clipped pluck line suggests vocal-chop phrasing without depending on samples.
